schema.tint: null = authored colours (caller tint ignored) | #hex | palette:NAME[.key] | palette:auto (legacy per-id colour); baked multiply, caller Color overrides
schema.saturation: optional 0..1, applied after tint (locked states pass 0 at call time; plan e)
schema.badge: optional {svg, corner:"br", scale}: a second pack icon composited at the corner (combined icons); registries that ignore it show the base icon

missing.note: Forge Mirror op / Appearance (transmog): no pack match (Shield Mirror reads as a shield). Keep ui/icons/mirror.svg (lead call).
2H tag: no pack icon. Keep a text chip "2H".
No turret/cannon. Mapped to Satellite Dish (weak). Alternative: keep current mech_turret.svg.
No cape/cloak in the pack. Keep ui/icons/cape.svg restyled to the Outline look, or use Clothing/Outfits PB.
13 back/cosmetic items (capes, backpacks, pelts): only Clothing/Backpack fits the two backpacks; others keep the 3D thumbnail + cape glyph.
No bear hat. 3D thumbnail + slot glyph.
paladin_cuirass, barbarian_harness, mage_robe, rogue_leathers, ranger_tunic, ninja_gi, druid_robe, dino_suit: no matching clothing; 3D thumbnail + Armor Chestplate slot glyph.
Die-kind corner marks (chevrons, diamond, ring, weight, bars, spark, crown, bone, dino print) stay procedural in die.gdshader/die_face.gd: they must read at 10 px on a die.
In-world SDF intents (intent_icon.gdshader) can be replaced by the SVGs above rendered into the unit HUD chip; keep the SDF path as fallback for perf on web.
Combos (pair..six_kind) have no icons today; keep text.
pet_<id> ids stay UNMAPPED on purpose: they are our own portrait SVGs (in-run pet HUD, pet beats). Pack glyphs live under petg_<id>.
Passive rarity ring stays procedural (colour ring), drawn by passive_icon.gd around the pack glyph.
Level medallion + XP ring stays procedural.
